resources.string: Attention Stats: Digital Wellbeing & BrainRot Shield

Attention Stats records estimated video and photo encounters in your enabled Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok and Snapchat sources. An encounter is not a watch. Optional numeric playback measurement records advancing player time, 3-second watches and observed completions only where supported.

For these enabled sources only, screen layout and labels are read in memory, fingerprinted and discarded. Captions, authors, messages, typed input, screenshots, audio and video are never saved. Other apps are not read for content. Optional app schedules check only the foreground package of apps you selected.

Only when you choose them, the service shows counters, break screens or app-schedule covers, presses Back to leave a blocked short-video player, or swipes for auto-scroll. System navigation and recovery remain available.

History stays encrypted locally. Manual encrypted export transfers a file only to a destination you choose; that provider may upload it. No developer server or automatic Drive backup. Pause, change your choices or delete local history in Attention Stats.
